catatan.id: Pensiun dini lewat ADB Energy Transition Mechanism dibatalkan pemerintah (Des 2025) karena biaya kompensasi PLN sekitar Rp 60 triliun untuk percepatan 5 tahun; dana ETM akan dialihkan ke PLTU lebih tua di Jawa yang belum dipilih.
catatan.en: Early retirement under the ADB Energy Transition Mechanism was cancelled by the government (Dec 2025) over about IDR 60 trillion compensation for a 5-year acceleration; ETM funds are to move to an older Java plant not yet chosen.

catatan.id: Prioritas kedua CIPP JETP. Kapasitas dilaporkan 1.050 MW (CREA) atau 969 MW (Katadata); GEM mencatat tiga unit 350 MW. CREA memperkirakan 5.409 kematian dihindari dan USD 3,7 miliar pada 2038-2043.
catatan.en: Second JETP CIPP priority. Capacity reported as 1,050 MW (CREA) or 969 MW (Katadata); GEM lists three 350 MW units. CREA estimates 5,409 deaths and USD 3.7 billion avoided in 2038-2043.
